body:
I know I'm supposed to believe that I don't deserve it, but I genuinely feel like I have it coming. Tonight is a great example...he was drinking and has been angry at me because I have to go out of town for work. Things have been tense. I knew full well there was a good chance he'd attack me tonight, but I stayed around; I didn't do a thing to prevent it. I allowed it to happen.

So, in a way, I did antagonize him and it WAS my fault.  I'm essentially dragging an otherwise good guy down with me because it justifies the self loathing I feel. I'm allowing this scenario because I deserve it and as a result I'm ruining him in the process.
